caption:
A few small things that make the darker weeks easier.

Number 1 has NHS backing. For seasonal affective disorder, the NHS suggests getting as much natural daylight as you can, and for some people a light box helps. Even a grey lunchtime outside gives you far more light than an office.

Number 2 helps me most. Something small to look forward to every week, even a coffee with a friend on Wednesday, makes the dark weeks go quicker.

If low mood sticks around, please talk to your GP. SAD is common and there's help for it.

Save this for the dark weeks ahead, and send it to someone who finds winter hard.
